description: Per-task canonical subtask templates for closed-loop VLM-CoT. Derived from the phrasing patterns in data/robotwin2.0_subset4_lerobot/meta/episodes.jsonl so that each template is in-distribution for the pretrained WAM. The VLM may enrich a template with one short visual-grounding clause (color, material, position) but must choose one of the listed subtask indices (1-based).

hanging_mug.summary: Long-horizon dual-arm: left arm pick mug -> rotate -> place center -> right arm hang on angled rack.
stages: Use the left arm to pick up the mug from the table.
Rotate the mug and place it in the center of the table.
Use the right arm to pick up the mug from the center of the table.
Hang the mug onto the rack with the right arm.

open_microwave.summary: Short single-arm: grab handle then pull door open along a curved arc.
stages: Use the left arm to grab the microwave door handle.
Pull the microwave door open with the left arm.

place_can_basket.summary: Long-horizon dual-arm: left arm pick can -> place in basket -> right arm lift basket.
stages: Use the left arm to pick up the can from the table.
Place the can into the basket.
Lift the basket up with the right arm.

turn_switch.summary: Short single-arm: press the switch. Visual grounding (which area of the switch to target) is the main VLM-CoT value here.
stages: Press the switch with the left arm.
